assets.title: Sleeved Marker Flag
assets.description: One original static low-poly marker-flag visual prop: a low ground-supported foot, thick through-bored socket, slender shouldered pole, solid retaining stop ring and a genuinely open vertical sleeve continuously joined to one thick, gently folded blank rectangular flag. The pole seats with finite opposed faces on the foot and socket; the sleeve sits on the finite stop-ring face, with complete radial clearance from the pole and a readable upper gap. Five closed connected meshes, three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, native Z up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin and front -Y. No lettering, national or event symbols, extra flags, map, terrain, textures or animation. Static visual geometry only: no cloth/wind simulation, meteorology, direction or route accuracy, visibility rating, traffic/rescue signal meaning, wind resistance, stability/load performance, manufacturing or safety certification. No mounting compatibility with earlier map or harbor props.
